title: Vocabulary dropbox file
description: Contract for a dropbox/*.yaml file proposing one or more vocabulary terms. Derived vocabularies should specialize the field names and descriptions to match their LinkML schema.

suggester.description: File-level default suggester. Applied to every entry that does not set its own suggester.

terms.description: The list of proposed terms. This key should match TARGET_CLASS in the Makefile.

orcid.description: Canonical ORCID URL, for example https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097.

id.description: Subject IRI, CURIE, or local identifier. Optional for new terms; generated during minting when absent.

exact_matches.description: External identifiers equivalent to this term.
